items.title_zh: 这是印度最被误解的蛇，它为它的外表付出了代价
items.title_en: This Is India’s Most Misunderstood Snake That Pays The Price For Its Looks
items.summary_zh: 大多数人将狼蛇误认为是普通金环蛇，出于对自身安全的恐惧而将其杀死。因此，尽管狼蛇无害，但经常被不必要地杀死。
items.summary_en: Most people mistake the wolf snake for the common krait and kill it out of fear for their safety. As a result, despite being harmless, the wolf snake is often killed unnecessarily
